searchText: Hedera works with sequential numbers. The biggest issue is needing to know the address a-priori or to coordinate the number. For example if an exchange sends to a new account how do you communicate it? This is a proposal in-process to allow for an alias for a few key operations (account creation and account query) - https://hips.hedera.com/hip/hip-32 So there is still a mapping, but it is limited to the address and the alias only.
